Title: Lilith's Blessing against alternate discipline granting cards (LSJ)

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
Does Lilith�s Blessing work with any of the alternate discipline
granting master cards?

Or, does it only work for those cards with the names of disciplines
(and Agent of Power)?

Lilith�s Blessing
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may tap this card
to search your library for a Master : Discipline card and choose a
ready non-Bahari vampire you control who has no blood. That vampire
gains the Discipline card (if any) and 3 blood and becomes Bahari.

Agent of Power [LotN:C, HttB:PSam4]
Cardtype: Master
Master: Discipline. Trifle. Unique.
Put this card on a vampire you control and choose a Discipline. This
vampire gains 1 level of that Discipline. Burn this card during your
discard phase.

Blooding by the Code [LoB:C, HttB:PSal2]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Salubri antitribu
Cost: 1 pool
Capacity: +1
Master.
Put this card on a Salubri antitribu you control. This Salubri
antitribu gains one level of Valeren [val] and gets +1 strength.
Capacity increases by 1: the Salubri antitribu is one generation
older. A vampire can have only one Blooding by the Code.

Infernal Pact [Sabbat:R, BH:PTr, Third:R/PTr]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Tremere antitribu
Cost: 1 pool
Unique master.
Put this card on a Tremere antitribu you control and choose a
Discipline. The vampire with this card can play cards that require
that Discipline as though he or she has the superior version of that
Discipline.

Proxy Kissed [KMW:C, LotN:PG2]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Giovanni
Capacity: +1
Master: out-of-turn.
Put this card on a Giovanni when you move him or her from your
uncontrolled region to your ready region during your influence phase.
This Giovanni gains one level of Potence [pot] and one level of
Fortitude [for]. His or her capacity is increased by 1. Move 1 blood
from the blood bank to this Giovanni.

Spontaneous Power [Promo-20050611]
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Unique master.
Put this card on a vampire and choose a Discipline. This vampire gains
1 level of the chosen Discipline. While in play, this card counts as a
master: Discipline card.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jun 19, 11:54 am, The Lasombra <TheLasom...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Does Lilith s Blessing work with any of the alternate discipline
> granting master cards?
> Or, does it only work for those cards with the names of disciplines
> (and Agent of Power)?

The latter: it only works with "master: Discipline" cards.

(like diablerizing an older vampire will only grant "master:
Discipline" cards. Also like Absorb the Mind does, and Bamba and other
things that say "master: Discipline")
